featured_reviews.name: Arshiya Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely Helpful Photo Studio Near Korean Consulate!

I had a wonderful experience with this photo studio near the Korean Consulate. I was in urgent need of a passport-sized photo that met the specific requirements for the South Korean visa application — something many regular studios don’t always get right. This studio, however, knew exactly what was needed.

The staff was very professional and patient. They asked me the purpose of the photo right away and adjusted the background, lighting, and size accordingly. They even showed me sample Korean visa photo dimensions to double-check before printing. The photo was taken and printed within 10–15 minutes, and the quality was excellent — clean, crisp, and clear.

What really stood out was their attention to detail. They helped fix minor things like hair framing, head tilt, and facial expression, which made a big difference in how the photo turned out. They even gave me extra copies without charging much.

For anyone visiting the Korean Consulate in Mumbai and needing visa or passport photos urgently, this place is a lifesaver. It’s reliable, affordable, and extremely convenient. I highly recommend it — especially if you're on a tight deadline and can’t afford to have your visa application rejected over photo issues!

The costume team, with a keen eye for detail, dresses models and actors in garments that not only fit but tell a story, each stitch carefully placed to match the vision.

featured_reviews.name: Bhagyashree Chaudhari
featured_reviews.review_text:
1★ Highly disappointed with the service*

We booked them for my brother’s wedding. Engagement was on 24th Dec and the package was around 33k which included photos, cinematic video, and an Instagram reel. We finalized them because their Instagram page looked really good.

The photos were delivered on time, but the editing was very basic – just looked like a filter was added and sent. After continuous follow-up, 2 months after the engagement they provided a poorly edited video and reel. The cinematic video was poorly cut and the quality was very poor. The reel was even worse – completely amateur work, nothing like what they post on their own page.

Worst part is after taking the full 33k upfront, they have been ignoring our calls and WhatsApp messages for the last 4 months. Zero accountability.

We trusted them with our memories and paying 33k for this service was heartbreaking. Don’t go by their social media. Extremely unprofessional team

featured_reviews.review_text:

Ajit has an eye for detail and a unique ability to capture the essence of the event. The candid shots were especially wonderful, reflecting the joy and emotions of the day perfectly. The team was also very accommodating, ensuring that all our requests were met with a smile.

The final photos were delivered promptly, and the quality exceeded my expectations. Ajit Photography truly made our engagement memorable, and I am grateful for their outstanding service. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for top-notch photography.
